evals.prompt: The MCP behind this existing Pluxx project added three tools. Preview a safe sync, preserve our custom notes, then explain whether the taxonomy needs another pass.
evals.expected_output: A JSON dry-run review before sync that interprets added, updated, removed, preserved, renamed, and warning entries; reports custom-content and persisted-taxonomy impact; then applies deterministic checks and recommends refinement only when meaning changed.

evals.prompt: Our local stdio MCP moved from ./build/index.js to ./dist/server.js. Update the existing Pluxx project without assuming the installed bundles still work.
evals.expected_output: A source override or sync plan that checks runtime payload paths, rebuilds from source, and requires installed-state verification.

evals.prompt: Sync says a generated skill was removed, but that file still contains our operator notes. What should happen?
evals.expected_output: A preservation-first explanation that identifies stranded custom content, describes Pluxx preservation and rename behavior, requires an explicit keep-relocate-retire decision, and avoids silent deletion or edits in dist.
